mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 66 degrees at Verona Area High School.

The City of Verona encourages residents to stay informed through their digital newsletter, which covers vital projects and programs. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects, including Ardent Glen and new proposals at 1979 Milky Way, ahead of their November 4th meeting.

We have plenty of activity this week, starting with trivia at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow features yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmers market, and pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a report covering incidents from September 28 to October 5, an officer arrested a 19-year-old on October 3 who was found in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's featured flavor is the refreshing Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and will remain open until 11 PM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
